item.title: Two Critical PHP Flaws: What to Check and Patch Today
item.dc:creator: ShapeHaven Innovations
item.description: Two critical PHP remote code execution flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, were announced October 21. Here is who is affected, which versions fix them, and what to do if you cannot patch yet.

item.title: mDNSShark: See Everything on Your Wi-Fi, Without Sending a Byte Out
item.dc:creator: ShapeHaven Innovations
item.description: Why we built mDNSShark, a free, open-source iPhone network scanner and packet monitor that finds, assesses, and inspects devices on your Wi-Fi entirely on-device, with no telemetry.

item.title: World Monitor: An Open-Source Dashboard Built for AI Agents
item.dc:creator: ShapeHaven Innovations
item.description: Why we're watching World Monitor, an open-source global intelligence dashboard that ships an MCP server alongside its REST API, treating AI agents as first-class clients.
